def is_a_remote_mirror(mirror: str) ->bool:
    if not mirror:
        return False
    # Check if it's a URL (remote) by looking for common URL schemes
    if mirror.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
        return True
    # Check if it's a file path (local) - this is a simplified check
    if mirror.startswith('/') or mirror.startswith('./') or mirror.startswith('../'):
        return False
    # If it doesn't start with a scheme or local path indicators, assume it's remote
    # This handles cases like 'https://example.com/db.json' or just 'db.json' 
    # but we want to distinguish between local files and remote URLs
    return True
